Remaining: eye, gold, hand, heart, sand, snowflake, tooth.

The best question would split these 3/4 or close to it. Checking the candidates:

- "Can you hold it in one hand?" Gold yes, sand yes, snowflake yes, tooth yes. Eye, heart, and hand are ambiguous, so this is messy.
- "Is it round?" Eye yes, and maybe heart and sand, so it is also ambiguous.
- "Can you see through it?" Probably none, or the snowflake.
- "Is it found in the sky?" Only the snowflake, which is 1/6.
- "Is it usually kept indoors?" Doesn't separate them cleanly.

"Can you hold it in one hand?" is the weakest of these because of how many are ambiguous. "Is it bigger than a breadbox?" is no for all of them, so it is useless.

"Is it round?" gives eye yes, heart no, hand no, tooth no, gold no, sand no, snowflake no, so it is 1 vs. 6.

"Is it made mostly of metal?" gives gold only.

Body parts are eye, hand, heart, and tooth. Non-body are gold, sand, and snowflake. None of the listed questions asks about body parts directly, but "Does it have legs?" and "Is it a mammal?" don't help either.

The best option is "Can you hold it in one hand?". Likely answers are gold yes, sand yes, snowflake yes, tooth yes, eye maybe yes, heart maybe yes, hand no. That is not a good split either.

"Is it usually kept indoors?" gives no for all of them.

I'll go with 3.

**3**
